title: Senior Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role
Build and evolve AirSpot, a mobile app that lets the public report drone sightings while giving law enforcement and defense teams the information they need to understand what's happening in the airspace around them.
You'll work across the full mobile surface: real-time geospatial data, reporting workflows, maps, alerts, feeds, and offline-capable experiences. The app is already under development with React Native and Expo; you'll join an early team, co-own the architecture, and help take it from an early product to a production-grade application used by real people.
This is a hands-on senior engineering role. You'll make architectural decisions, build features end to end, improve performance and reliability, and help establish the engineering practices that the mobile team will grow around.
What you'll do

• Build and ship production mobile features with React Native, Expo, TypeScript, and Expo Router.

• Own architectural decisions across state management, data fetching, offline behavior, navigation, and the mobile build/release pipeline.

• Build geospatial experiences with MapLibre, including real-time location and map interactions.

• Improve performance and reliability across startup time, animations, lists, memory, battery, and crashes.

• Establish reliable testing with Jest, React Native Testing Library, and Maestro.

• Own production delivery with EAS, including builds, signing, releases, and app store readiness.

• Contribute to backend APIs when useful and help establish engineering standards as the team grows.

• Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery without compromising quality.

About you

• Several years of professional software engineering experience, including at least two production React Native apps with real users.

• Strong React Native, TypeScript, and Expo experience, including the New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules, Bridgeless).

• Experience with mobile performance, testing, observability, and production releases.

• Hands-on experience with MapLibre, Mapbox, Google Maps, or comparable mobile mapping technologies.

• Evidence of owning architecture or major technical decisions, not just implementing predefined features.

• Strong engineering judgment, pragmatic problem-solving, and the ability to work independently in a small team.

• University-level technical education in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.

• Eligible to work in Germany and, where required, for EU/NATO security clearance.

Nice-to-haves

• Node.js, Bun, or other backend experience.

• Reanimated, Gesture Handler, and advanced React Native animations.

• Geospatial, aviation, ADS-B, drone, or real-time location experience.

• Experience with EAS/Fastlane and mobile CI/CD.

• Defense, law enforcement, or other regulated-environment experience.

• German language skills.

• Open-source contributions to React Native or Expo.

• Practical experience with AI coding agents and modern AI-assisted development.

What we offer

•
Own the mobile architecture: Shape a greenfield product and its technical direction.

•
Modern stack: React Native, Expo, New Architecture, Reanimated, MapLibre, TanStack Query, and Zustand.

•
High ownership: Work in a small team where your decisions have direct product impact.

•
Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin/Dresden and other off-site locations.

•
Flexibility by default: Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.

title: Technology Partnerships Manager
description:

You will own relationships with technology partners that have strong go-to-market, referral, and co-sell potential-helping both organizations identify opportunities, enable their sales teams, and win business together.

This is not a partner utilization or integration-support role. Success will be measured by partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, co-sell activity, and revenue generated through the technology partner ecosystem.

HiBob has a broad and growing ecosystem of integrations, with significant opportunity to expand the Marketplace and deepen partner go-to-market engagement. This role will identify, recruit, and activate high-potential partners that can generate meaningful referral opportunities and mutual growth. It’s an exciting time to join HiBob . Salesforce is leading a $166 million investment in the company, supporting our vision to bring trusted people context into the AI-powered enterprise. As we accelerate our product, technology, AI, and innovation roadmap, you’ll have the opportunity to help shape what comes next. What you bring

• Experience in technology partnerships, alliances, channel sales, business development, or a related GTM role within B2B SaaS.

• A track record of building partnerships or GTM motions from scratch and creating measurable pipeline or revenue impact.

• Experience partnering directly with sales teams on referrals, co-selling, account planning, or deal strategy.

• Ability to understand and communicate APIs, integrations, and technical product capabilities to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong cross-functional stakeholder-management skills and the ability to align organizations with different priorities, cultures, and sales motions.

• A hands-on, resourceful approach; comfortable creating momentum with limited dedicated partner-marketing support.

Preferred

• Experience in HR tech, payroll, workforce management, or a related SaaS ecosystem.

• Experience working with a Marketplace, integration ecosystem, or API-based technology platform.

What you'll do

• Identify, recruit, onboard, and grow technology partners with strong referral, co-sell, and revenue potential.

• Build trusted relationships with partner-side sales, alliances, product, and executive stakeholders, and enable their teams to identify when and how to position HiBob .

• Partner with HiBob AEs to uncover shared opportunities, strengthen deal strategy, and execute co-sell motions that help close business.

• Build joint GTM plans and revenue-generating initiatives, including partner enablement, webinars, events, and co-marketing campaigns.

• Work closely with Product and R&D to assess integration opportunities, discuss API capabilities, and translate technical value into customer and commercial value.

• Align internal and external stakeholders across two organizations-Sales, Product, RevOps, Support, Marketing, Customer Success, and Legal-to move partnerships forward.

• Track partner performance across referrals, pipeline, revenue, co-sell activity, and engagement.

Benefits
At HiBob , our people are at the heart of everything we do.

We’re building a global village of ambitious, thoughtful, and talented Bobbers who want to do the best work of their careers. With a vibrant NYC office and remote teammates across the country, we’ve created an environment where people can be themselves, grow quickly, and make a real impact.

Joining HiBob means working alongside exceptional people while being supported with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and pre-IPO equity, including the perks below.

• 401(k) with a 3% company match effective the month following your start date

• $2,500 employee referral bonus

Health & Wellbeing

title: Mathematics Specialist (Fluent in Dutch) – AI Trainer
description:
Are you a mathematics expert fluent in Dutch, eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of scientific discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline academic work for students and professionals everywhere. That training data begins with you-we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.
We’re looking for mathematics specialists who live and breathe algebra, calculus, number theory, linear algebra, differential equations, statistics, geometry, mathematical logic, and discrete mathematics. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like real and complex analysis, optimization theory, mathematical proofs, set theory, probability distributions, cryptographic algorithms, and applied mathematics-documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.
On a typical day, you will converse with the model on classroom problems and theoretical mathematics questions, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.
A master’s or PhD in mathematics or a closely related quantitative field is ideal; peer‑reviewed publications, teaching experience, research in pure or applied mathematics, or hands‑on experience with mathematical modeling signal fit. Clear, metacognitive communication-“showing your work”-is essential.
Ready to turn your mathematics expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.
We offer a pay range of $6-to‑$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

title: Vice President, Engineering, EPM
description:
About Us:
insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware .com.
Job Description:
As Vice President of Software Engineering for our Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) portfolio, you will lead a global organization of engineers across multiple product lines that finance teams rely on to plan, close, consolidate and report. You will own how that portfolio is built, shipped and run.

2027 is a transformation year. We are modernizing established applications, building new SaaS and multi-tenant capabilities, moving to an agentic software development lifecycle, and putting AI directly into the hands of our customers. We need a leader who can deliver all four at once without compromising the quality and reliability our customers depend on for their most critical financial processes, and who measures success with the same discipline our customers apply to their numbers.

We enjoy our work as much as we enjoy working together, and we want leaders who get things done while having a positive influence on our workplace environment.

What you will deliver in 2027

1. Modernize legacy applications

• Define and execute a modernization strategy for the EPM portfolio, choosing deliberately between re-platform, re-architect, strangler-pattern migration, and retirement for each product and component

• Sequence modernization to deliver customer value incrementally, avoiding big-bang rewrites and protecting customers already in production

• Reduce technical debt measurably, with a visible debt register, investment targets and progress reported to executive leadership

• Plan and execute customer migrations from on-premise and single-tenant deployments with clear data-integrity, cutover and rollback plans
2. Build SaaS and multi-tenant capabilities

• Lead the design and delivery of cloud-native, multi-tenant services, including tenant isolation, data partitioning, configuration and extensibility models

• Build the shared platform capabilities that product teams rely on: identity, observability, metering, tenant provisioning, and self-service environments

• Own SaaS operational excellence: SLOs and error budgets, on-call and incident management, capacity planning, cost efficiency, and disaster recovery

• Embed security, privacy and compliance (for example SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) into architecture and delivery pipelines rather than treating them as downstream gates
3. Deliver with an agentic SDLC

• Lead the shift from AI-assisted coding to an agentic software development lifecycle, where AI agents participate in planning, coding, testing, code review, documentation and operations

• Establish the guardrails that make this safe: human review policy, test and evaluation gates, provenance and traceability of AI-generated changes, and secure handling of code and data

• Redesign team workflows, roles and skills for agentic delivery, and coach engineering managers and engineers through the change

• Measure the impact rigorously, proving gains in flow, quality and reliability rather than tracking adoption alone

4. Build customer-facing AI features

• Partner with Product to deliver AI capabilities that finance users trust, such as natural-language analysis, forecasting assistance, anomaly detection and agentic workflows across planning, close and reporting

• Build the engineering foundations for production AI: model and prompt management, retrieval over governed financial data,

title: SoC Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops custom silicon and systems for advanced AI workloads. Our first-party accelerator team works across chip architecture, design, software, and systems to build the computing platforms that power frontier models. We are a small, dynamic team that values technical breadth, hands-on engineering, and creative approaches to building complex hardware.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a SoC Engineer to help architect, design, and integrate OpenAI’s first-party AI accelerators. You will build the processor, interconnect, I/O, and platform infrastructure that connects our accelerator designs into complete, functional systems.

This role combines architectural judgment with hands-on implementation. You’ll work closely with design, architecture, verification, and software teams throughout development, from defining subsystem requirements and integrating IP to pre-silicon validation, silicon bring-up, and post-silicon debug. You should enjoy stretching across domains, rolling up your sleeves, and doing the work needed to make a complex system function end to end.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Define and implement SoC architectures spanning embedded processors, AMBA interconnects, peripheral subsystems, PCI Express, Ethernet and die-to-die interfaces.

- Develop the microarchitecture and RTL design of subsystems supporting I/O and SoC functionality.

- Integrate Arm Cortex-M and Cortex-A processors, AXI/APB fabrics, and third-party controller IP, including the RTL and glue logic needed to connect these components.

- Develop reset and boot architectures, working with firmware and software teams to define sequencing, initialization, and survivability behavior.

- Incorporate debug, test, and security requirements into the SoC architecture and implementation, partnering with other silicon designers to make the silicon observable, testable, and secure.

- Drive PCIe and other I/O integration, including controller and PHY interfaces, high-speed SerDes, and die-to-die connectivity.

- Contribute to power management and security architecture and design.

- Work directly with third-party IP vendors to define technical requirements, evaluate IP capabilities, coordinate deliverables, and resolve issues from integration through silicon bring-up.

- Work across architecture, design, verification, physical design, and software teams to define interfaces, resolve integration issues, and carry designs through pre-silicon validation and post-silicon bring-up.

- Work closely with Firmware and Software teams to define boot, configuration and runtime behavior and functionality.

- Build and apply automation and AI-assisted tools to accelerate design, IP integration, consistency checking, and debugging while maintaining engineering quality.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have experience in SoC architecture, RTL design, and subsystem or full-chip integration, with hands-on ownership through implementation and silicon bring-up.

- Are familiar with Arm processor subsystems, including Cortex-M and Cortex-A, and AMBA protocols and interconnects such as AXI and APB.

- Understand PCIe protocols and have experience configuring, integrating, and debugging controller IP.

- Have experience integrating high-speed I/O, including SerDes/PHY interfaces and die-to-die links.

- Have experience working directly with third-party IP vendors to evaluate technical fit, communicate requirements, and drive integration and debug issues to resolution.

- Understand reset and boot architecture and the interactions between hardware, firmware, and software during initialization and recovery.

- Have experience designing for debug, test, and security, and can reason about how these requirements affect the broader system.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Verifies test requisitions by comparing information with orders and requisition documentation; brings discrepancies to the attention of Natera product management leadership.

• Verifies patient by reading patient identification.

• Obtains blood specimens by performing venipunctures and finger sticks.

• Maintains specimen integrity by using aseptic technique, following Natera[KC1]  procedures; observes isolation procedures.

• Tracks collected specimens by initialing, dating, and noting times of collection; maintaining daily tallies of collections performed[MB2]  in Natera provided system.

• Maintains quality results by following Natera procedures and testing schedule; recording results in the quality-control log; identifying and reporting needed changes reporting KPIs to product management leadership on biweekly basis.

• Maintains safe, secure, and healthy work environment by following standards and procedures; complies with legal regulations.

• Resolves unusual test orders by contacting the physician, pathologist, nursing station, or reference laboratory; referring unresolved orders back to the originator for further clarification; notifying internal Natera team [MB3] of unresolved orders. Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations.

• Enhances Natera’s phlebotomy reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests; exploring opportunities to add value to job accomplishments.

• Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.

• This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and has access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic), in order to perform the job.

• Report any SPI or CAPA or NCR issues to internal Natera product management leadership team Assists with managing all phlebotomy equipment associated with the establishment and running of the patient service center[KC4] , may require heavy lifting of up to 50 pounds of supplies.

• May require reimbursable travel for stocking of supplies May include onboarding, training, and retraining of individual phlebotomists, as deemed necessary to support volume increases.

• Assists with managing Patient Service Center vendors.

• Assists with phlebotomy program management: Monitor distribution and claiming of blood draws Monitor customer feedback Manage small escalations as needed

• Manage scheduling issues

• Ensure continued and open communication regarding ongoing draw statuses General phlebotomy knowledge for PSC’s location (per state regulations) 

• Must maintain a current status on Natera’s training requirements.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Minimum of 5 years of phlebotomy experience

• 5+ years high-level customer care experience Managing/supervising phlebotomy operations and teams experience preferred BS/BA degree (preferred)

• High School Diploma (or equivalent) required Phlebotomy Certification (or equivalent) preferred, except where regulatory regulations are mandated

Evio has advanced analytics and contracting capabilities at scale , and a suite of digital tools , to power our high-cost medication solutions. Our solutions act as a self-reinforcing “flywheel” where each element strengthens and feeds into the next, and support an “Only Evio can do that,” mindset and prioritization.

Empathy - The people our business serves always come first. We care for our teammates and put ourselves in the shoes of our health plan customers and the patients and clinicians our solutions benefit.

• Explore data to identify signals, trends, utilization patterns, and anomali

title: CISO
description:

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

Verkada is at a critical stage in its evolution as it scales its global business. With that growth comes an increasingly complex security landscape spanning connected devices, cloud infrastructure, AI and machine learning at the edge, and sensitive customer video and access data.

Building on an established security program and a team of approximately 30, the incoming CISO will have the opportunity to evolve the strategy, technical capabilities, and operating model for Verkada’s next stage of growth. Priorities include strengthening device and product security, advancing detection and response, protecting customer data, and meeting expanding regulatory requirements across global markets.

As part of the engineering leadership team, the CISO will operate as a technical partner to Engineering and Product, embedding security into how Verkada designs, develops, and deploys its technology. This requires a leader who can pair technical depth with the organizational discipline needed to scale the security function while supporting innovation and speed.

For the right leader, this is an opportunity to address a distinctive set of security challenges at the intersection of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world-and to shape a security organization whose impact extends directly to customer trust, product integrity, and Verkada’s readiness for its next chapter.

What You'll Do

The CISO will lead and scale Verkada’s security organization of approximately 30 professionals, evolving its capabilities to support continued growth and readiness for a potential IPO. As a member of the CTO’s engineering leadership team, this leader will partner across engineering, product, legal, and business functions to manage security risk while supporting innovation.

• Security strategy and organizational leadership: Set security priorities, develop talent, and scale the team’s capabilities and responsibilities as the business grows.

• Device and product security: Partner with product and firmware engineering to secure Verkada’s Linux-based device fleet, including AI/ML workloads at the edge and the software update lifecycle.

• Cloud and software security: Lead security across cloud infrastructure and software, embedding security practices into development and operations.

• Detection and response: Oversee security operations, automated threat detection, incident response, and continuous improvement of monitoring and response capabilities.

• Data protection: Strengthen safeguards for customer and company data across devices, applications, and cloud services.

• Global compliance and regulatory readiness: Lead security compliance across jurisdictions, including Europe and Australia, and mature the program for the company’s next stage.

We are growing our teams with the most thoughtful, creative, and driven people on the planet.
NVIDIA is seeking a software engineer with systems software and security experience to join the Data Center Systems Software team. You will investigate and resolve product vulnerabilities and strengthen Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices for platforms including HGX, DGX, and MGX.

What You’ll Be Doing:

• Investigate and reproduce vulnerabilities, assess exploitability and impact, and identify affected products and software versions.

• Develop or review security fixes, validate mitigations, develop regression tests, and coordinate updates across supported releases.

• Build automation for vulnerability triage, analysis, and tracking.

• Improve SDL practices through threat modeling, security design reviews, and other best-practices.

• Evangelize and drive SDL practices across NVIDIA data center software teams.
What We Need to See:

• BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of relevant software or security engineering experience.

• Hands-on experience investigating and remediating vulnerabilities, including familiarity with CVSS scoring and CWE classification.

• Experience with secure development practices and security testing tools, such as static analysis, fuzzing, and software composition analysis.

• Familiarity with server firmware and systems software, plus experience building automation using Python or a comparable language.

• Experience with modern AI and Agents, including AI-forward mindset and proactive adoption of cutting-edge tools and techniques.

• The ability to drive resolution across distributed and diverse engineering teams.

• Solid technical foundation in embedded systems, with the ability to engage credibly in technical discussions around firmware architecture, memory safety, and hardware-software interfaces.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a strong preference for written communication that creates clarity and institutional memory for a remote team.

• Comfortable with ambiguity and complexity; you make sound decisions quickly with incomplete information and course-correct without friction.
Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

• Product security experience with modern data center systems.

• Knowledge of secure boot, root of trust solutions, attestation, and related technologies such as UEFI, SPDM, or TCG DICE.

• A track record of improving SDL adoption or security automation across engineering teams.

• Demonstrated vulnerability research, security fixes, or open-source security contributions.

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business - where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent - it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior SecOps Engineer to take ownership of security operations at Flagstone. That covers everything from alert triage and incident response through to detection engineering and continuous improvement of how our SOC works.

This is a hands-on role that sits right at the operational end of security. You’ll spend real time in the alert queue, as well as building the detections and automation that make it better. You’ll be right in the middle of complex investigations and P1s, while also shaping how the function operates. You’ll also own our relationship with our managed SOC provider, setting the standards they work to rather than simply receiving their output.

About the team

You’ll sit within Security Engineering, reporting to our Security Team Leader. In this role you’ll own detection, triage and incident response, and act as the technical counterpart to our managed SOC provider. That means directing their scope, holding them to clear detection and response standards, and keeping ownership of anything escalated or high severity in house.

Does this sound like you?

You’re an engineer at heart. You’d rather write the detection than describe it, and you treat detections and automation like any other engineering work: version controlled, tested and documented. You’re the go to expert when something serious happens, and you can explain security risk just as clearly to engineers as to senior stakeholders.

You’re curious about new technology, AI included, and you have a clear view on where it genuinely helps and where it introduces risk.

What you’ll do

You’ll take ownership of our SOC operations and report on their performance and health to stakeholders across the business. You’ll run investigations and incident response for complex or high severity alerts, managing parallel workstreams, keeping stakeholders informed and running post incident reviews through to real changes in detections or process.

You’ll own the detection engineering backlog, building, tuning and retiring detections across Microsoft Sentinel and Defender, mapped to a coverage model such as MITRE ATT&CK. You’ll turn threat intelligence into detection logic and hunting activity, and drive our automation and SOAR maturity by building Logic App playbooks that reduce manual effort without losing judgement on the nuanced cases.

You’ll manage our managed SOC relationship day to day: defining scope and escalation criteria, reviewing performance against SLAs and acting as the technical escalation point for anything they can’t close. You’ll keep playbooks, escalation paths and documentation in shape so the practice scales beyond any one person, and you’ll track metrics like triage time, false positive rate and coverage gaps to drive continuous improvement.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (London)
description:
ABOUT EDRA

Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations.

We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. We're a deeply technical team of engineers, AI researchers, and strategists with a high bar for talent and a shared belief that exceptional people are the foundation of everything great we'll build.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join our infrastructure team as the second-in-seat hire. Our team ships fast enough that we're starting to hit GitHub's rate limits, and infrastructure has to stay a month ahead of that. You'll be in key engineering meetings to ensure our infrastructure is ready before anyone asks, and to catch any decisions that may become infrastructure problems later.

This is not a ticket queue. You'll decide what gets built, push back when a managed service already does what someone wants to hand-roll, and invent when no pattern exists. You'll also write real software, not just the infrastructure code underneath it. We run containerized workloads on AWS and GCP, defined in infrastructure as code, with Postgres underneath. Some of our early infrastructure was built quickly before anyone owned it full-time. Part of the job is untangling that while keeping the team moving.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own our cloud infrastructure end to end: provisioning, security, reliability, and the infrastructure as code that defines it.

- Stay ahead of the engineering roadmap and have infrastructure ready before features land, working directly with the founders on where the infrastructure goes next

- Find where developers are waiting and remove the wait, whether that's CI, deployment, or environment spin-up. A person sat waiting is the most expensive thing we run, so rational spend on velocity is always on the table

- Run the reliability practice: monitoring, logging, and alerting that fails loudly with a clear signal, and the response when it does

- Lead large infrastructure builds and own our product security posture

- Make the build-vs-managed-service call, and hold the line when the simpler path is the right one

- Read and write Python well enough to see the infrastructure implications of what the team's building and catch problems before they land

- Own AI model safety and the governance of agentic processes. The team leans on agents for repetitive work, and you make sure nothing unsupervised can act on production infrastructure

- Hand capability to others, and support the team cross-functionally: build the tooling that lets engineers, GTM, the AI team, operations, and compliance do without you what today requires you

- Keep current across cloud and model providers so that when an engineer brings a new announcement, you have a credible answer

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 5 to 10 years in infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering

- Deep, recent experience running production workloads on AWS or GCP, defined in infrastructure as code. A wide toolkit with one or two areas you go deep on. You won't know every service, and we expect you to learn fast

- Python you've written in anger, in or alongside application code

- Postgres in production, and containerized workloads running under an orchestration platform

- A security instinct: you think about vulnerabilities continuously and patch constantly

- Evidence that you've held down an infrastructure function alone or in a very small team

- Work you can point to where you found an ambiguous problem, designed the fix, and made other people faster as a result

- Comfort saying no to senior people when the infrastructure demands it

RBONUS POINTS

- GCP experience, especially migrations or multi-cloud rollouts

- CloudWatch

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Tech Lead
description:
About OpenMined

OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise.
About the Role
We're looking for a Senior / Staff Software Engineer to join OpenMined , a nonprofit building open-source infrastructure for federated AI.
You’ll lead our 😱 ScreamingFace squad, the team that makes this vision real by building the internet's first leaderboard for fusion models (ensembles) and the open toolkit supporting benchmark evaluations for fusion models. Today, claims that the newest solo LLM beats the others are everywhere, and almost none of them can be checked or compared with the performance achieved by combining LLMs into more powerful fusion models. Results are self-reported, expensive to rerun, and hard to pick apart. We think there’s a better standard: every fusion and benchmark run compiles to a single line of text that anyone can replay for almost nothing, and a score counts only once someone else can reproduce it. The ScreamingFace toolkit is the open-source Python library and engine, leveraging our URL4 protocol, to let any researcher (a frontier lab, a university group, an independent builder) compose ensembles and routers across open and closed models, using their own keys, and grade them against pinned benchmarks. The ScreamingFace leaderboard is the public map of the quality-cost frontier, backed by a shared cache that makes every result on it cheap to verify and easy to build on.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role . You understand the long term vision. You write code. You make architecture decisions. You set engineering standards by example. You're the most experienced engineer on the squad, the person others look to for production-quality judgment, and the voice that connects this team's decisions with the organization's broader platform strategy.
The squad is talented and mission-driven and looking to strengthen its ability to continuously ship production software. You bring this production muscle: the instinct for what scales, the judgment about what to build and what to kill, and the craft to raise the team's standard through code review, pairing, and architectural guidance rather than mandates.
If you're motivated by building distributed systems that matter, mentoring brilliant people who are just getting started, and making hard technical calls in a fast-moving nonprofit that's trying to change how the world shares data - we'd love to hear from you.
You'll work most closely with Kevin McDonough, Head of Engineering.
This is an independent contractor engagement, roughly a full-time commitment, with an initial 12-month term we expect to renew. You set your own schedule, but we need your working hours to overlap substantially with US Eastern business hours (your local time within about one hour of ET).

• Own the ScreamingFace squad technical architecture end to end - align design, engineering, and deployment across the stack to deliver reliable technical capabilities and user experience from current implementation through product roadmap evolution.

• Drive production readiness through deployment monitoring, error handling, graceful degradation, and operational runbooks.

• Be a force multiplier by establishing, demonstrating, and mentoring the team to establish norms around engineering best practices (including system design for modularity, security, reliability, & scalability), code quality, and delivery to production.

title: Market Development Manager — EMEA

Auditdata already powers the largest groups in the industry. The question this role answers is which markets and which companies come next.
As Market Development Manager you own how Auditdata enters and grows beyond its established accounts across EMEA: which markets are worth opening, which chains are worth pursuing, and what it takes to get in. You will shape that view with the VP EMEA and then go and prove it in the market yourself. This is a build role, working alongside the people who actually decide - no layers to push through, no waiting for permission.
Your mandate:

• Market selection: build the commercial case for where Auditdata expands next and turn it into a prioritised target map across EMEA.

• Market entry: create the first real pipeline in countries where we have no presence and close the deals that establish us there.

• Demand: turn interest into qualified opportunity across the region and make sure what we generate matches what we have decided to go after.

Who you work with the VP EMEA on strategy and prioritisation, the VP Marketing as an equal partner on campaigns and account-based programmes against your target map, the Account Managers and Account Executives when an opportunity grows into an enterprise cycle. Pre-sales and customer success are yours to call on. Product Management is your partner in crime for shaping how to enter new markets.
What You Will Do:

• Build the EMEA target map: enter new markets, new chains, new segments, and provide the reasoning for pursuing each.

• EMEA wide inbound & outbound motions: prioritise what is important vs urgent, you are the owner of your own success across the region.

• Open conversations at the owner, operations and clinical leadership levels in companies that do not yet know us.

• Carry and close your own quota of Enterprise & mid-market deals, within your EMEA territory.

• Partner with marketing on positioning, campaign design and follow-up, so demand generation and direct outreach pull in the same direction.

• Bring the market back into the business: what competitors are doing, what buyers are asking for, where the product needs to go.

• Keep HubSpot as the single source of truth, and own a pipeline forecast the business can plan on.

What You Bring:

• 3+ years generating pipeline and winning new logos in B2B software or medtech, with success cases you are proud of.

• Proven ability to build a target market from scratch rather than work a list handed to you.

• Commercial judgement: you can argue why one market or account deserves our attention over another.

• Comfort with CRM and modern prospecting and automation tooling; HubSpot is a plus.

• Fluent English plus one additional European language - German, Dutch, French, Italian or Spanish.

• Curiosity about healthcare and a willingness to learn the audiology domain properly.

• A self-directed mindset: you will be creating this territory, not inheriting it.

What’s in It for You:

• Remote-first and async-friendly with a flat organizational structure.

• A modern IT environment: leading AI tools, HubSpot CRM and the means to automate your go-to-market.

• A real career path and leadership track, with development and certification support.

• A global, diverse team across 30+ nationalities.

title: Sustainable Forest Management Consultant – Thailand
description:
Title: Sustainable Forest and Management Plan Development for Thamma Raksa Project
Location: Thailand
Team: Operations Asia
Reports to: Project Manager
Status: External Consultant

PUR Description
PUR is a global, impact-focused B-Corp specializing in the development of environmental restoration projects, known as ‘nature-based solutions’ (NbS). Since 2008, we have been helping the world’s largest organizations meet their ESG targets, reduce their environmental footprint, and regenerate the ecosystems they depend on across complex supply chains. Having developed over 45 projects in more than 30 countries, PUR is recognized as both a pioneer and leader in a sector that is now at the forefront of global efforts to address the ongoing climate and biodiversity crisis.
At the heart of our mission is a commitment to fostering and operationalizing insetting strategies-interventions by companies within their own value chains designed to reduce GHG emissions while creating positive impacts for communities, landscapes, and ecosystems. By championing this insetting approach, we aim to create a holistic range of benefits that extend beyond ecological restoration, encompassing social and economic dimensions through enhanced agricultural yields and resilience to climate change-induced stresses, among others.
One of the distinctive features of our work is our ability to tailor projects to the specific needs of different regions and communities. By recognizing the unique characteristics of each ecosystem and the cultural context of the communities involved, we ensure our initiatives are contextually relevant and have a meaningful and sustainable impact. All our projects are developed in close collaboration with local actors, including cooperatives, NGOs, governments, and corporations. Today, we employ 200 staff across 16 countries with key offices in Paris (HQ) and Toronto.
Thamma Raksa Project | PUR

PUR is looking for an experienced Sustainable Forest Management Consultant to support the development of a comprehensive Sustainable Forest Management Plan (SFMP) for the Thamma Raksa Project in Isaan, Thailand .
The project focuses on agroforestry and small-scale forest plantations across several provinces in Northeast Thailand. The consultant will develop practical forest management, selective harvesting, post-harvesting and farmer training approaches that support long-term forest health, carbon storage and farmer needs.
About the Assignment
The main objective of this consultancy is to develop a practical and comprehensive Sustainable Forest Management Plan aligned with:

• Verified Carbon Standard (VCS) Version 5.0

• VM0047

• ABACUS Label

• Symbiosis Quality Criteria

The plan will cover different planting models, tree species and ecological and socio-economic contexts across Isaan, Thailand.
Key Responsibilities
The consultant will be responsible for:

• Developing the Sustainable Forest Management Plan for the Thamma Raksa project.

• Developing appropriate maintenance practices , including pruning, thinning, weeding and pest management.

• Developing guidelines for selective harvesting , including tree selection, harvesting volumes, timing and methods.

• Conducting tree growth, biomass and harvesting analysis to support harvesting schedules and carbon-stock projections.

• Developing recommendations for post-harvesting management, replanting and natural regeneration .

• Considering Thailand's forestry regulations, land tenure and socio-economic context.

• Developing a practical monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) framework .

• Supporting farmer engagement and developing practical training materials.

• Translating technical recommendations into practical guidance for farmers and field implementation partners.

Key Deliverables
The consultancy will include:

• Sustainable Forest Management Plan - English, Word and PDF

• Farmer-friendly summaries - English and Thai

• Harvesting Schedule & Biomass Growth Impact Dataset - Exc

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. The Role
Veeva's Vault Clinical Data Management System (CDMS) is changing how life sciences companies manage clinical trial data, bringing EDC, coding, and Data Quality System (DQS) together in one platform. The Migration Team works within this group, focusing on migrating customers off legacy systems-such as Medidata Rave and Oracle InForm-into Vault CDMS.

In this full-time, customer-facing role , you will serve as a trusted, customer-facing technical lead, partnering directly with Sponsors throughout active migration programs.
What You’ll Do

Partner directly with Sponsors and CROs to interpret legacy clinical database structures, protocol specifications, and data mapping requirements, applying Veeva migration best practices.

Perform data transformation, mapping, and script validation on large, complex clinical datasets extracted from legacy platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm).

•
Lead end-to-end data migration delivery across complex, active clinical trials per the project plan, coordinating closely with cross-functional technical teams.

•
Develop and configure validation scripts, and custom SQL-based listings to ensure data integrity, auditability, and cleanliness during ingestion into Veeva DQS and Vault CDMS.

•
Provide feedback to the Vault CDMS & DQS product teams based on real-world customer migration challenges, data volume bottlenecks, and client requirements.

•
Contribute to reusable migration tools, data mapping templates, and automation initiatives , mentoring junior team members throughout the migration lifecycle.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience with EDC clinical software, covering end-to-end data management (database design, data collection, data analysis, query resolution, datasets, statistical reporting)

• Programming experience in languages such as SAS, R, Python, or SQL, with the ability to pick up new SQL-based languages

• Background in the life sciences industry (pharma, biotech, medical device, CRO, or academic/public health), with experience across project assessment, planning, development, training, and implementation

• Experience in a customer-facing role, ideally within software professional services or consulting

• Strong verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills

Nice to Have

• Knowledge of DBT

• Familiarity with data management standards (GCDMP, CDISC, SDTMIG, CDASH, ADaM)

Why This Role Is Different

•
Production-first. Reliability is the product for customers who rely on us 24/7. You will ship safe, repeatable delivery, not experiments.

•
Platform and product. You will build the foundations that the whole team and portfolio stand on. One solid platform multiplies everyone's velocity.

•
Domain-first, not tech-first. You will learn the domain well enough to know what "reliable" means to customers running mission-critical operations.

•
A founding role. As an early hire, you will establish the delivery and on-call culture and help raise the bar as we grow.

•
Pragmatic build or buy. You will make pragmatic build or buy decisions on infrastructure and tooling, without gold-plating.

What You'll Do
Foundations and Delivery

• Build and own cloud landing zones, infrastructure-as-code and the Kubernetes foundations the team builds on.

• Own CI/CD as a product: fast, safe, repeatable delivery.

• Automate away toil, and codify operational knowledge into tooling and runbooks.

Reliability and Observability

• Establish observability (metrics, logs and traces), SLOs and alerting, so the platform is measurable and debuggable.

• Set up and mature on-call and incident response, and drive reliability improvements from postmortems.

Deployment and Cost

• Support deployment into both cloud and customer-managed environments, and manage version and configuration drift.

• Optimise cost and capacity, including for AI workloads.

Delivering Value with Product and Customers

• Work with product teams and customers to validate results and outcomes, prioritising by value.

• Take a value-based development approach: prove value with the smallest useful slice, then scale what works.

• Instrument and measure impact, letting evidence rather than opinion drive what ships.

• Build automated QA, including tests, quality gates and regression checks, into the delivery pipeline.

Building the Team and Ways of Working

• Help build the team by establishing on-call and reliability culture, and mentor as we grow.

• Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession and pragmatic shipping.

• Partner with product teams across the portfolio who own their own roadmaps.

What You'll Bring

•
Production infrastructure: You have built and run production cloud infrastructure and owned its reliability.

•
Operations as engineering: You treat operations as engineering, not ticket-driven ops.

•

Azure depth: Landing zones, networking and identity on Azure.

Customer-managed environments: Shipping software into environments the vendor does not fully control.

Regulated delivery: Delivery into regulated or restricted environments.

Compute cost: Cost optimisation for GPUs or other expensive compute.

•
Languages: Comfortable in Python, C#/.NET or Go for tooling and automation.

•
Architecture: System and platform design, and trade-off judgement such as one-way versus two-way doors.

•
Enterprise scale: Ex
